summary: Hamilton resurrects his pole-position pedigree with Ferrari, claiming his first grid-topper in three years at the high-altitude Mexico City circuit where thin air demands precision setup and aggressive driving. Verstappen carries grid penalties from a Friday practice clash with Lawson into Sunday's race, handing opportunity to a field hungry to capitalize on the championship leader's compromised starting position. A victory here tightens or loosens the title fight dramatically—Hamilton's momentum shift to the Scuderia collides with Verstappen's vulnerability in a race that historically punishes mistakes and rewards tire management in Mexico's unforgiving conditions.
